items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: But I guess I know it was Lee Wiley and other people named that I can think of.

ctx.x: Was Steve Smith's wife really interested and involved in things?

Well yeah, she was much interested in jazz too. She liked it. What was her name? Lee Smith. Lee Smith. L-E-E. Strange name in a way for a girl. But I guess I know it was Lee Wiley and other people named that I can think of.
Let me move this mic a little closer to you. Your voice is soft.
